cards.example_en: Our guide pointed to the northern tropic on a globe.
cards.example_zh: 导游指了指地球仪上的北回归线。
cards.explain_zh: 回归线用单数；热带地区固定用the tropics。

cards.example_en: Communities in the tropics often depend on seasonal rainfall to sustain agriculture and maintain reliable freshwater supplies.
cards.example_zh: 热带地区的社区往往依赖季节性降雨来维持农业生产和稳定的淡水供应。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Don't delude yourself into thinking the work is finished.
cards.example_zh: 别自欺欺人地以为工作已经完成了。
cards.explain_zh: 常用delude oneself into doing，指自欺欺人地做某事。

cards.example_en: Don't delude yourself into thinking the work is finished.
cards.example_zh: 别自欺欺人地以为工作已经完成了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Users often fumble with unfamiliar controls, highlighting the importance of intuitive design in public transport systems.
cards.example_zh: 使用者操作不熟悉的控制装置时常常手忙脚乱，这凸显了公共交通系统中直观设计的重要性。
cards.explain_zh: fumble for表示摸索寻找；with表示笨拙摆弄。

cards.example_en: The documentary showed a savage fight between two wolves.
cards.example_zh: 这部纪录片展现了两只狼之间的激烈搏斗。
cards.explain_zh: 勿用作名词称呼族群，有贬损和冒犯意味。

cards.example_en: The proposed reduction in education funding attracted savage criticism from teachers and parents across the country.
cards.example_zh: 削减教育经费的提议遭到了全国教师和家长的严厉批评。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Your advice was invaluable when I bought my first bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 我买第一辆自行车时，你的建议帮了大忙。
cards.explain_zh: invaluable意为极宝贵，不是没有价值。

cards.example_en: Factories should cease discharging untreated wastewater into rivers to protect aquatic ecosystems and safeguard public health.
cards.example_zh: 工厂应停止向河流排放未经处理的废水，以保护水生生态系统和公众健康。
cards.explain_zh: 较正式；后可接动名词或to do，均表示停止。

cards.example_en: Your kind words will gratify everyone who helped today.
cards.example_zh: 你的暖心话会让今天所有帮忙的人感到欣慰。
cards.explain_zh: 较正式；常用be gratified by表示因某事欣慰。

cards.example_en: After an eventful morning, we finally sat down for lunch.
cards.example_zh: 经历了状况不断的一上午后，我们终于坐下来吃午饭。
cards.explain_zh: 指发生许多值得注意的事，不一定都是坏事。

cards.example_en: A bright plume decorated the dancer's tall hat.
cards.example_zh: 舞者的高帽上装饰着一根鲜艳的大羽毛。
cards.explain_zh: 既指大羽毛，也指形似羽毛的烟柱、水柱。

cards.example_en: I felt dubious about buying a bicycle without brakes.
cards.example_zh: 对于买一辆没有刹车的自行车，我心存疑虑。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到怀疑用dubious about；事物可疑也可用dubious。

cards.example_en: I felt dubious about buying a bicycle without brakes.
cards.example_zh: 对于买一辆没有刹车的自行车，我心存疑虑。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A short walk broke the monotony of my afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 短暂的散步打破了我下午的单调乏味。
cards.explain_zh: 通常为不可数名词，强调缺少变化带来的乏味。

cards.example_en: The boat's propeller churned the water into white foam.
cards.example_zh: 船的螺旋桨把水搅成了白色泡沫。
cards.explain_zh: propel是推进；propeller是提供推力的螺旋桨。

cards.example_en: This tractor has enough horsepower to pull the heavy trailer.
cards.example_zh: 这辆拖拉机的马力足以拉动那辆沉重的拖车。
cards.explain_zh: 数量后horsepower不加s；它衡量功率而非速度。

cards.example_en: The museum displayed uniforms once worn by the local militia.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了当地民兵曾经穿过的制服。
cards.explain_zh: 指组织；单个成员用a militia member。

cards.example_en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
cards.example_zh: 我们的花园每年夏天都结出大量番茄。
cards.explain_zh: 常用an abundance of＋名词，或in abundance。

cards.example_en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
cards.example_zh: 我们的花园每年夏天都结出大量番茄。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The lift stopped halfway up the narrow shaft.
cards.example_zh: 电梯在狭窄井道的中途停了下来。
cards.explain_zh: 井道用shaft；英式lift shaft对应美式elevator shaft。

cards.example_en: Engineers installed a ventilation shaft to improve air quality throughout the underground transport station.
cards.example_zh: 工程师安装了通风井，以改善整个地下交通站点的空气质量。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The forecast predicted rain, so we dressed accordingly.
cards.example_zh: 天气预报说有雨，所以我们相应地穿好了衣服。
cards.explain_zh: 表“相应地”常放句末；表“因此”较正式。

cards.example_en: We met outside the bakery in the shopping precinct.
cards.example_zh: 我们在步行商业区的面包店外碰面。
cards.explain_zh: 指建筑物周围的区域时，通常用复数precincts。

cards.example_en: We met outside the bakery in the shopping precinct.
cards.example_zh: 我们在步行商业区的面包店外碰面。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
cards.example_zh: 厚窗帘帮助减轻了街上传来的噪声。
cards.explain_zh: 正式用词，直接接风险、损害或影响，不表示彻底消除。

cards.example_en: Planting trees in urban areas can mitigate the effects of extreme heat and improve residents' quality of life.
cards.example_zh: 在城市地区植树可以减轻酷热的影响，并改善居民的生活质量。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Lena showed maturity by calmly admitting her mistake.
cards.example_zh: 莉娜冷静地承认自己的错误，表现得很成熟。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；金融语境中at maturity表示到期时。

cards.example_en: Schools can foster emotional maturity by encouraging students to resolve disagreements respectfully and consider different perspectives.
cards.example_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生尊重他人地解决分歧并考虑不同观点，从而促进其情绪成熟。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please stow your bag under the seat in front.
cards.example_zh: 请把包放好，置于前方座位下。
cards.explain_zh: stow away可指收好；人作主语时也可指藏匿偷乘。

cards.example_en: The band's vocalist sang softly while the guitarist played.
cards.example_zh: 吉他手弹奏时，乐队的歌手轻声演唱。
cards.explain_zh: 常指乐队中的歌手；lead vocalist意为主唱。

cards.example_en: The club is lax about checking membership cards.
cards.example_zh: 这家俱乐部对会员卡的检查很松懈。
cards.explain_zh: 常指规则执行不严；不要用它表示日常的腹泻。

cards.example_en: Lax enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to discharge untreated waste into nearby rivers.
cards.example_zh: 环境法规执行不严，使一些工厂得以向附近河流排放未经处理的废物。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
cards.example_zh: 我的皮肤在寒冷天气里容易干燥。
cards.explain_zh: prone to后接名词或动名词，通常指不好的情况。

cards.example_en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.
cards.example_zh: 随着海平面上升和极端风暴日益频繁，沿海居民区越来越容易遭受洪灾。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.
cards.example_zh: 学校可以定期布置需要共同承担责任的任务，让学生习惯合作。
cards.explain_zh: accustom oneself to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: The extra paperwork became burdensome during our busiest week.
cards.example_zh: 在我们最忙的那一周，额外的文书工作成了沉重负担。
cards.explain_zh: 多形容任务、费用或规定，不指物体重量。

cards.example_en: Overly burdensome regulations may discourage small businesses from expanding, even when demand for their products is strong.
cards.example_zh: 过于繁重的监管规定可能阻碍小企业扩张，即使其产品需求旺盛也是如此。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These family photos helped us establish the chronology.
cards.example_zh: 这些家庭照片帮助我们确定了事情发生的先后顺序。
cards.explain_zh: chronology是名词；按时间顺序用chronologically。

cards.example_en: Establishing an accurate chronology allows historians to examine how environmental changes influenced the development of early settlements.
cards.example_zh: 建立准确的事件时间序列，有助于历史学家研究环境变化如何影响早期聚落的发展。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Buying fresh flowers every week is my only extravagance.
cards.example_zh: 每周买鲜花是我唯一的奢侈享受。
cards.explain_zh: 指挥霍行为通常不可数；指某项奢侈享受时可数。

cards.example_en: Repeated cheating led to his expulsion from the club.
cards.example_zh: 反复作弊导致他被俱乐部开除。
cards.explain_zh: 常用expulsion from；对应动词为expel。

cards.example_en: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
cards.example_zh: 无论年龄大小，人人都可以参加这次步行活动。
cards.explain_zh: 通常用irrespective of＋名词，意为“不论”。

cards.example_en: Late returns may incur an extra charge at this library.
cards.example_zh: 在这家图书馆，逾期归还可能产生额外费用。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式 incurred，现在分词 incurring，均双写 r。

cards.example_en: Sift the flour before adding it to the bowl.
cards.example_zh: 把面粉筛过后再加入碗中。
cards.explain_zh: sift through表示仔细查看，寻找有用信息。

cards.example_en: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
cards.example_zh: 我们买了些木料，准备做一张花园长椅。
cards.explain_zh: 木材义多用于美式英语，英式通常用timber。

cards.example_en: Small fish sheltered among the roots of a mangrove.
cards.example_zh: 小鱼躲在一棵红树的根部之间。
cards.explain_zh: 可指一棵红树；红树林常说mangrove forest。

cards.example_en: Water-saving irrigation systems squirt small amounts of water directly onto roots, reducing waste in dry regions.
cards.example_zh: 节水灌溉系统将少量水直接喷向根部，减少干旱地区的水资源浪费。
cards.explain_zh: 常用squirt液体onto/into某处，强调细流喷出。

cards.example_en: Without a car, we are reliant on local buses.
cards.example_zh: 没有汽车，我们只能依靠当地公交车。
cards.explain_zh: 固定搭配reliant on；“自立的”是self-reliant。

cards.example_en: Without a car, we are reliant on local buses.
cards.example_zh: 没有汽车，我们只能依靠当地公交车。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Creating a pedestrian precinct can encourage local shopping while reducing traffic pollution in city centres.
word.example_zh: 设立步行商业区既能鼓励本地消费，又能减少市中心的交通污染。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Countries heavily reliant on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
word.example_zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
